top_signals.title: Gold Edges Lower as Hot US Inflation Bolsters Fed Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold edged lower, after hotter-than-expected US inflation data raised prospects that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Forced Into the Right Decision? A Look at U.S. Land-Based Deterrence Posture
top_signals.summary:
In 2019, Steve Fetter wrote “A Cheaper Nuclear Sponge,” in which he argued that building a new intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) was unnecessary for strengthening U.S. land-based deterrence. After several years of changing defense budgets and strategic priorities, we asked Steve to revisit his arguments.Image: U.S. Air Force (John Ingle)In your 2019 article, you argued that building an entirely new ICBM was unnecessary and that the Pentagon could save tens of billions by extending the life of the Minuteman III instead. top_signals.title: Microsoft sees some new wrinkles in invoice-scam emails
